page.notes: The catchword "Lysi-" and the signature "Q 3" are at the foot. The running head "CAPVT XX." and page number 245 are at the top. Faint show-through text from the other side of the leaf (e.g. "Plantago", "Anethum", "Mentha") is not transcribed. Spelling "Cuscutha" and "Cypressus" read from long-s forms "Cufcutha" and "Cypreffus".
